source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved CSM Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without selecting an incompatible legacy/UEFI boot path or losing recovery/management access.
original_method: Change CSM fields in BIOS, save/reboot and re-enter BIOS to verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while checking normal reboot, logs and applicable boot-path health.
manual_activity: A human must operate the CSM firmware page, execute both save/reboot/default phases and visually verify settings. Automated OS/boot-mode inventory only supports the manual acceptance.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS identity and CSM support status
Named CSM fields with baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Installed OS/media partition and firmware boot-mode compatibility
Boot entries and Secure Boot dependency
Console/operator, stable power, compatible recovery media and BMC/OOB access
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or change legacy/UEFI mode without exact boot compatibility.
Do not repartition, rewrite boot loaders or enroll/delete Secure Boot keys as an implicit part of this case.
Preserve compatible recovery media and an alternate management path before saving.
Stop on missing OS/media, wrong boot target, Secure Boot incompatibility, hang or management loss.
Restore the approved final CSM/boot state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware boot entries, disk partition style, OS boot mode, Secure Boot state and BMC/OS health evidence.
Compare firmware captures and boot-path evidence with the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, modify boot records/disks/keys, choose a boot target or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve CSM fields/defaults, compatible boot path, recovery media and final state.
Evaluate firmware and applicable boot/management evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; boot-mode and disk inventory is read-only supporting evidence and must not expand into boot-record or partition changes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual CSM workflow and add approved read-only boot-entry, OS-mode, partition-style and Secure Boot snapshots; do not substitute hypervisor/OS settings.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase BIOS sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; OS boot validation is platform/project supporting scope, not silently added mandatory source coverage.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved CSM value to compatible firmware boot entries, media/partition style, OS mode and Secure Boot expectation; capture firmware state and read-only boot evidence at baseline, persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS and installed/recovery boot artifacts; some platforms may not support CSM.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, OS/bootloader and recovery-media versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform CSM/UEFI boot specification and project OS/media compatibility definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit boot compatibility and non-destructive evidence while preserving both BIOS transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful OS boot is supporting evidence only when included, and no bootloader/partition mutation is implied.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: CSM defaults, boot artifact compatibility and recovery path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A normal BIOS reboot does not prove every legacy/UEFI media path; coverage must name the tested artifacts.

project_override_considerations: The project may select supported CSM fields and named boot artifacts. If CSM is absent or prohibited on the platform, record applicability rather than inventing a replacement feature.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, boot-entry/media/partition/Secure Boot baseline and recovery
First save/reboot persistence and applicable boot-path evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and boot/management health
Final CSM/boot state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing boot artifacts and compatibility definitions are readiness inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CSM setting lifecycle is clear. Compatibility and recovery details gate execution but do not make the generic case permanently BLOCKED; platform non-applicability is recorded separately.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual BIOS boundary and adds boot-compatibility/recovery safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its read-only boot/Secure Boot evidence but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY because the firmware action and observation are core, while avoiding unrequested disk or bootloader changes.

review_improvement: Prevents CSM testing from making the installed OS or recovery media unbootable and prevents post-boot inventory from being mistaken for automated BIOS acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware interaction and visual persistence/default verification are the decisive test operations. Agent-collected boot-mode evidence does not automate them, so MANUAL ONLY is required under V3.1.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a CSM change, boot attempt or default load after incompatible media, missing boot entry or management loss; preserve evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
